name: Hand-holding mode: a paired walk at her pace
body: Hold a button to take her hand: she walks beside the player at a fixed offset and her pace. A crowd surge or a slip breaks the hold. Release is always possible.

comments.text: Filed 2026-11-21 before any code, from Dean's 'Gameplay Direction: Finding Her' doc (searching as the core mechanic, not a platformer).

acceptance_criteria: Holding the button pairs the walk at her pace
The hold breaks at an authored surge
